scene: The stone arch opens onto a lively transit hub for three routes.
picture: Side-view along a paved greenhouse concourse. On the far left, a red koi-shaped wooden boat bobs at a dock. In the centre, the grandfather stands holding his bicycle with crate of plants. Right of centre waits an ornate brass garden lift. On the far right sits a green garden tram on tracks.
shown: a carved koi-shaped boat moored at the canal dock on the far left
an ornate brass-caged garden lift with open doors right of centre
a green open-sided garden tram resting on tracks at the far right
